title: RUIPRO 8K Detachable Full Fiber Optic Armored HDMI 2.1 Cable, 48Gbps, Support 8K@60Hz 4K@120Hz, Dynamic HDR, eARC, Compatible with PS5/Xbox/HDTV/Blu-ray/Monitor/Projector
description:
Key Features: 

  • Compatible with HDMI 2.1 standard and backwards compatible with HDMI2.0/1.4.
  • Stainless steel armored structure of the cable ensures bend flexibility, tensile strength, compression resistance, and tangle-free performance.
  • Up to 300m long run for date rate 48Gbps(12Gbps/ Channelx4Channel).
  • Supports 4K/ 8K compressed and uncompressed mode.
  • Supports SDR, HDR, Dynamic HDR (HDR10+ and DV), ARC, e-ARC, VRR, ALLM, QTF, QMS, CEC
  • Supports resolution up to 8K@60Hz, 4K@120Hz and supports HDCP1.4/2.2/2.3.
  • Supports computer resolutions to 5K/100-120p 4:4:4 10Bit and 10K/24-30p 4:4:4 10Bit
  • Bi-directional fiber cable with 7 optic wires ( 50/125 um OM3)
  • Plug and Play, no loss of signal, Anti-EMI. 
  • CE, ROHS, REACH certified.

 

Specifications:

  • RUIPRO MPO cable : 7 core Type A
  • Limit bending radius: D30mm, 10 circles can work
  • Power Consumption: 280mW-600mW(max)
  • Power Supply: 5V USB (USB power supply on the TX/source end is usually not needed, but the display end must be powered. Without power, the cable won't  function.)
